metadata.name: cross_core
metadata.description: Opening Cross core: escrow, commit-reveal order entry, sharded aggregation, uniform-price clearing, claims and refunds.

instructions.name: abandon_settlement
docs: Deferred-mint crosses: if no base mint was bound by the deadline, anyone may abandon
settlement; the cross becomes a no-print and every order is refunded in full.

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: Second step: the proposed admin signs to take over.

instructions.name: bind_base_mint
docs: Deferred-mint crosses: the registered settler binds the base mint it created after the
clear. The cross PDA must already hold the mint authority.

instructions.name: cancel_order
docs: Withdraws an order during the call window. Full refund, no fee. Remaining accounts: the
applicant record, then the class book, when the rules call for them.

instructions.name: challenge_insider
docs: Alleges that `subject` was an undeclared insider; posts a deposit (ADR-0454).

instructions.name: claim
docs: Settles one order: pays its fill at the clearing price and refunds the rest. Anyone may
crank it; funds always go to the order owner. Closes the order account. A locked fill goes
to the cross's lock vault; remaining accounts: the lock vault, then the lockup record.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone may crank; pays for any missing owner token account.

accounts.name: base_mint
docs: Omitted only when nothing is paid in base (refunds of a deferred-mint cross).

accounts.name: base_vault
docs: Escrow mode only.

accounts.name: owner_base
docs: The owner's base account (create it first; the SDK adds an idempotent ATA creation).

instructions.name: clear
docs: Clears the cross once every shard is merged. Permissionless.
Remaining accounts, in this order and only those the stored rules call for (ADR-0450):
the halt state, then the base mint (halt rule, or float and valuation rules without a
declared supply), then the lender print feed.

accounts.name: oracle_price
docs: pinned feed (typically posted by the keeper in the same transaction); ownership, feed,
verification level and freshness are checked in `oracle_verdict`.

instructions.name: close_applicant
docs: Returns an applicant record's rent to its owner once the cross is finalized.

instructions.name: commit_order
docs: Places an order and escrows its funds. Sealed crosses take a commitment; open crosses
take the plaintext `price` and `quantity` and add them to the book immediately.
Remaining accounts, only those the cross's rules call for and in this order (ADR-0450):
the applicant record (identity limits), the class book (classes, insiders), the priority
pass (class 3 outside the early window).

accounts.name: order
docs: client-supplied bump, which `create_program_address` verifies (no bump search).

accounts.name: shard
docs: Required for open disclosure (the order's shard); omitted for sealed crosses.

accounts.name: escrow_mint
docs: cross in the handler, decimals come from the cross.

accounts.name: escrow_vault
docs: handler and by the token program on transfer.

accounts.name: owner_escrow
docs: owner signs for it and that its mint matches.

instructions.name: commit_order_ext
docs: `commit_order` with an allocation class and a lock (ADR-0453, ADR-0454).

accounts.name: order
docs: client-supplied bump, which `create_program_address` verifies (no bump search).

accounts.name: shard
docs: Required for open disclosure (the order's shard); omitted for sealed crosses.

accounts.name: escrow_mint
docs: cross in the handler, decimals come from the cross.

accounts.name: escrow_vault
docs: handler and by the token program on transfer.

accounts.name: owner_escrow
docs: owner signs for it and that its mint matches.

accounts.name: base_mint
docs: Omitted for deferred-mint crosses.

instructions.name: create_series
docs: Creates a recurring series of escrow crosses (ADR-0456).

instructions.name: draw_begin
docs: Starts the draw that closes an epoch or sets the extension length (ADR-0452). Anyone may
call it once the call, and any reveal window, is over.

instructions.name: draw_finish
docs: Finishes a draw from the block hashes that followed `draw_begin`, and applies it.

instructions.name: expire_challenge
docs: Anyone closes an insider challenge the arbiter has not ruled on within fourteen days; the
challenger's deposit returns and the bond is untouched.

instructions.name: finalize
docs: Distributes what is left once every order has been claimed: the issuer's proceeds and
fees in mint mode, accrued fees in escrow mode, the dust and bond remainder to
`proceeds_to`; then revokes the cross's mint authority in mint mode.

accounts.name: base_mint
docs: Required whenever the cross has a bound base mint.

accounts.name: base_vault
docs: Escrow mode only.

accounts.name: fee_recipient_quote
docs: May be the same account as the other payout accounts (e.g. an issuer acting as its own
integrator); Anchor never writes token accounts back, so aliasing is safe.

accounts.name: integrator_quote
docs: May be the same account as the other payout accounts (e.g. an issuer acting as its own
integrator); Anchor never writes token accounts back, so aliasing is safe.

accounts.name: proceeds_quote
docs: May be the same account as the other payout accounts (e.g. an issuer acting as its own
integrator); Anchor never writes token accounts back, so aliasing is safe.

accounts.name: proceeds_base
docs: Escrow mode only (receives base dust).

instructions.name: init_class_book
docs: Creates the class book a cross with allocation classes or declared insiders needs.

instructions.name: init_halt_state
docs: Registers the halt state of a base mint (ADR-0455). Signed by the mint authority or the
protocol admin.

instructions.name: init_lock_vault
docs: Creates the vault that holds the cross's locked tokens.

instructions.name: init_print_feed
docs: Registers the lender price feed of a base mint (ADR-0451).

instructions.name: log_ext
docs: Emits the cross's extension tail as an event (permissionless, read-only).

instructions.name: merge_shard
docs: Adds one shard into the book. Permissionless; each shard merges exactly once.

instructions.name: migrate_protocol
docs: Brings a protocol account written by an earlier layout up to the current one. Only the
stored admin may run it; it grows the account (the admin pays the extra rent) and sets every
field added since to its default. Idempotent: a current account is left unchanged.

accounts.name: protocol
docs: account may not deserialize under the current layout, which is why it is migrated).

instructions.name: observe_price
docs: Anyone feeds a verified oracle update to the asset's circuit breaker.

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: First step of an admin handover (e.g. to a multisig vault). Nothing changes until the
proposed admin accepts, so a mistyped address cannot lock the protocol. `None` withdraws it.

instructions.name: push_refunds
docs: Refunds up to twelve orders that are owed nothing but their escrow (a cross that did not print, or orders
that were not filled) in one transaction, to their owners' own token accounts. Anyone may call it.

accounts.name: base_mint
docs: Omitted only for a deferred-mint cross whose mint was never bound (no sells exist then).

instructions.name: release_locked
docs: Pays the vested part of a lockup to its owner. Anyone may call it.

instructions.name: resolve_challenge
docs: The arbiter rules on a challenge, slashing part of the bond when it is upheld.

instructions.name: reveal_order
docs: Reveals a sealed order during the reveal window and adds it to its shard. Remaining
accounts: the class book, when the cross has one.

instructions.name: series_withdraw
docs: The series' authority withdraws tokens the series holds.

instructions.name: set_arbiter
docs: The protocol admin names the arbiter that rules on insider challenges.

instructions.name: set_corporate_action
docs: The issuer authority flags or unflags a corporate action.

instructions.name: set_feed_publishers
docs: Changes who may publish to a lender price feed, and the minimum print size.

instructions.name: set_guardian
docs: The admin may rotate the guardian (the key allowed to pause new activity).

instructions.name: set_halt
docs: The issuer authority or the venue signer halts the asset. Only a printing resume cross
lifts the halt.

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Guardian or admin pause of new crosses and new orders. Reveals, clears, claims and
refunds are never paused.

instructions.name: set_protocol_fees
docs: Fee changes apply to crosses created afterwards; existing crosses keep their snapshot.

instructions.name: set_rules
docs: Fixes the rules of a cross (ADR-0450): the creator, in the slot the cross was created in,
before any order exists. Remaining accounts: the lender print feed when the cross feeds it.

instructions.name: set_series_active
docs: The series' authority pauses or resumes spawning.

instructions.name: spawn_next
docs: Spawns the next cross of a series when it is due. Permissionless. Remaining accounts: the
lender print feed, when the series' rules feed it.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the new cross's rent; anyone may.

accounts.name: series_quote
docs: The series' quote account: it pays the dust bond.

accounts.name: previous
docs: The previous cross; required from the second cross on.

instructions.name: sync_pause
docs: Anyone copies the mint's pause state into its halt state.

types.name: AllocationRules
docs: How the volume at the margin is shared (ADR-0453).

fields.name: reserve_bps
docs: Shares of the marginal volume reserved for classes 1, 2 and 3, in basis points.

fields.name: small_cap_quote
docs: Class 1 (identity-verified small orders): an order's escrow may not exceed this.

fields.name: lottery_unit
docs: Class 1 lottery: base atoms per lot (0 = pro-rata within the class). Every class-1 order
is then exactly one lot.

fields.name: min_lock_secs
docs: Class 2 (locked orders): the shortest lock a buyer may choose.

fields.name: lock_vest_secs
docs: Class 2: linear vesting after the lock, in seconds (0 = everything unlocks at once).

fields.name: early_until_ts
docs: Class 3 by early commitment: orders placed before this time qualify (0 = off).

fields.name: priority_gate
docs: Class 3 by status: the gate mint whose pass qualifies a wallet (a holder or supporter
credential).

fields.name: class1_cliff_secs
docs: Class 1 vesting (identity-bound vesting): fills unlock after this cliff...

fields.name: class1_vest_secs
docs: ...and then vest linearly over this many seconds.

fields.name: orders
docs: Live orders.

fields.name: escrow
docs: Quote escrowed in live buy orders.

types.name: Breaker
docs: Oracle circuit breaker settings and the last observation.

fields.name: window_slots
docs: Two observations further apart than this many slots are not compared.

fields.name: move_bps
docs: Halt when `|new − last| · 10_000 > move_bps · last`.

fields.name: last_publish_ts
docs: Publish time of the last accepted update: an older or equal one is never accepted again.

fields.name: subject
docs: The wallet alleged to be an undeclared insider.

fields.name: evidence
docs: Hash of the evidence kept off chain.

fields.name: qty
docs: Buy quantity per tick of classes 1, 2 and 3.

fields.name: tickets
docs: Class-1 orders per tick: the lottery tickets.

fields.name: insider_qty
docs: Buy quantity per tick of declared insiders.

types.name: ClearingExt
docs: Figures recorded at the clear when allocation classes or insiders are in play.

fields.name: class_qty
docs: Quantity of classes 1, 2 and 3 among the marginal buy orders.

fields.name: tickets
docs: Class-1 orders at the marginal tick (lottery tickets).

fields.name: rho
docs: Where the lottery window starts.

fields.name: insider_ub
docs: Upper bound on declared insiders' allocation (left out of the minimum raise).

types.name: ClearingSummary
docs: Clearing summary stored on the cross; mirrors `clearing_core::Clearing`.

fields.name: rationed
docs: 0 = none, 1 = buy, 2 = sell.

types.name: CommitOrderArgs
docs: Arguments for `commit_order`. Sealed crosses send the commitment and leave `price` and
`quantity` zero; open crosses send the plaintext order and a zero commitment.

fields.name: order_bump
docs: Bump of the order PDA, computed by the client.

types.name: CommitOrderExtArgs
docs: Arguments for `commit_order_ext`: those of `commit_order` and the order's class and lock.
(A separate type keeps `commit_order`'s arguments flat in the generated clients.)

fields.name: class
docs: Allocation class: 0 general, 1 identity-verified small, 2 locked, 3 priority.

fields.name: lock_secs
docs: Class 2: seconds the fill stays locked.

types.name: CompactRules
docs: The argument of `set_rules`: the same rules as [`RulesInput`] with the two padded lists sent unpadded, so that
the instruction and `create_cross` fit one transaction. [`CompactRules::into_input`] pads them and every check
runs on the padded form, as for a series.

fields.name: reveal_end_ts
docs: Ignored (set to `close_ts`) for open disclosure.

fields.name: calendar
docs: Schedule the cross on this calendar: its close must be a session start, and its oracle
feed (if any) must be approved by the calendar.

fields.name: schedule
docs: Mint modes only: the issuer's elastic supply schedule as sell levels.

fields.name: settler
docs: Deferred-mint mode only: the adapter authority allowed to bind the base mint.

fields.name: settle_deadline_ts
docs: Deferred-mint mode only: after this time an unbound cross can be abandoned and refunded.

fields.name: proceeds_to
docs: Receives the issuer's proceeds in mint mode and the dust/bond remainder in all modes.

fields.name: min_price
docs: Price grid: `min_price + i * tick` for `i < ticks`. Prices are quote atoms per
`price_scale` base atoms.

fields.name: gate_mint
docs: When set, only owners holding a `cross_gate` pass for this mint may place orders.

fields.name: buyer_paid
docs: Running settlement totals.

fields.name: oracle
docs: Optional oracle divergence guard (reopens of assets with a reference market).

fields.name: calendar
docs: Exchange calendar the cross is scheduled on (`cross_calendar`), if any.

fields.name: settler
docs: Deferred-mint crosses: the only signer allowed to bind the base mint, and the deadline
after which anyone may abandon settlement and refund every order.

fields.name: base_bound
docs: False until a deferred-mint cross has its base mint bound.

fields.name: version
docs: 0 = no tail (a legacy cross, or one whose tail was never initialised).

fields.name: created_slot
docs: Slot of the creating transaction; `set_rules` is only accepted in that slot.

fields.name: referral
docs: Referral: a share of the protocol fee paid to whoever brought the cross (ADR-0460).

fields.name: oracle_set
docs: More oracles than one (ADR-0459).

types.name: CrossExtSnapshot
docs: The cross's extension as stored, emitted by `log_ext` so that indexers and clients that do not
decode the tail themselves can read it from a transaction.

types.name: DrawState
docs: Draw bookkeeping (ADR-0452): which randomness is pending or settled, and what it decided.

fields.name: epoch
docs: 0 for the call as created, 1 once the extension has opened a second window.

fields.name: pending_slot
docs: Slot at which an unfinished draw began; 0 = none.

fields.name: pending_purpose
docs: 1 = the draw that closes an epoch, 2 = the draw that sets the extension length.

fields.name: end_bucket
docs: Last counted ending bucket; `NO_BUCKET` until drawn (all buckets count).

fields.name: ext_pending
docs: A clear failed its guards and the extension is waiting for its draw.

fields.name: aux_merged
docs: Merged auxiliary shards: bit `i` = ending bucket `i`, bit `8 + j` = extension shard `j`.

types.name: EndingRules
docs: The hard-to-game ending (ADR-0452). Zero switches a part off.

fields.name: ending_secs
docs: Length of the ending period that closes the call. Orders placed in it are bucketed.

fields.name: buckets
docs: Equal sub-windows of the ending period, `1..=MAX_BUCKETS` when `ending_secs > 0`.

fields.name: cancel_cutoff_secs
docs: No cancellation from this many seconds before the ending period starts.

fields.name: random_end
docs: The last counted bucket is drawn after the call: orders in later buckets are refunded.

fields.name: extension_min_secs
docs: A failed clear may extend the call once by a random length in this range.

types.name: GuardRules
docs: Rules that decide whether a cleared cross prints (ADR-0451). Zero switches a rule off.

fields.name: min_raise_quote
docs: Minimum raise in quote atoms.

fields.name: max_matched
docs: Hard cap on the base the sell side delivers (mint modes without sells).

fields.name: total_supply
docs: Declared fully diluted supply in base atoms; read from the base mint when zero and the
mint is known at the clear.

fields.name: anchor_price
docs: Anchor for the price-move guard; resolved at `set_rules` from the explicit anchor, the
reference price or the grid estimate, in that order.

fields.name: grid_estimate
docs: The issuer's estimate that the standard grid is built around.

fields.name: halt_source
docs: Halt state of the base mint; a halted or corporate-action mint does not print.

fields.name: multiplier_bits
docs: The multiplier of the base mint's scaled-UI-amount extension when the rules were set (`FLAG_GUARD_SCALED_UI`):
the bits of the `f64`, compared for equality and never used in arithmetic.

fields.name: authority
docs: The issuer's authority: may halt and flag corporate actions.

fields.name: venue_signer
docs: A venue (an exchange or a market operator) that may signal a halt.

fields.name: issuer_unpaused
docs: The issuer lifted its pause on the mint; the halt stays until a resume cross prints.

types.name: IdentityRules
docs: Per-identity limits (ADR-0453). They need a gated cross: an identity is the wallet that holds
the cross's gate pass, and a cap without an identity is theatre.

fields.name: cap_quote
docs: Most quote an identity may have escrowed in buy orders at once (0 = no cap).

fields.name: max_orders
docs: Most live orders an identity may have (0 = no limit; 1 = one application per identity).

types.name: Levels
docs: Per-tick aggregates. Used both for shards (written by orders) and the merged book.

types.name: NeutralityInput
docs: Declared insiders as `set_rules` takes them: only the ones named, where the stored form is padded to
`MAX_INSIDERS`. A transaction holding `create_cross` and `set_rules` together must fit in 1,232 bytes, and the
padding alone is 256 of them.

types.name: NeutralityRules
docs: Issuer neutrality (ADR-0454): declared insiders and the bond behind the declaration.

fields.name: insider_cliff_secs
docs: Insider fills unlock after this cliff and vest over `insider_vest_secs`.

fields.name: bond_quote
docs: Quote the creator posts behind the declaration; slashed on an upheld challenge.

fields.name: challenge_secs
docs: How long after the clear a challenge may be raised.

types.name: NeutralityState
docs: Bond bookkeeping.

fields.name: challenges
docs: Challenges filed so far; the next one's id.

types.name: OracleGuard
docs: Pyth price guard: the cross does not print if P* differs from the oracle by more than
`max_divergence_bps`, or if no fully verified price newer than `max_staleness_secs` exists.
The guard pins the Pyth **feed id**, not an account: Pyth's sponsored push accounts for US
equities were 24–40 days stale on mainnet (DP15), so the clearing keeper posts a fresh update
through the Pyth receiver (pull model) and passes that account. The receiver verifies the
Wormhole signatures; the guard accepts only fully verified updates for the pinned feed.

types.name: OracleSet
docs: Several oracles for one reopen (PRODUCT_FEATURES C1, VM9, C3): the cross's own `OracleGuard` names the first
Pyth feed; these name up to two more. The reference price is the median of the fresh, fully verified prices, the
guard needs a quorum of them, and outside the calendar's sessions the divergence bound is wider.

fields.name: quorum
docs: How many of the `1 + extra_count` prices must be usable (1 when there are no extra feeds).

fields.name: max_spread_bps
docs: The most the usable prices may differ from one another, in basis points of the lowest (0 = no limit).

fields.name: off_hours_widen_bps
docs: Added to the divergence bound while no session of the cross's calendar is open (0 = no widening).

types.name: OracleSetInput
docs: The extra oracle feeds as `set_rules` takes them: only the ones named (see [`NeutralityInput`]).

fields.name: commitment
docs: Sealed crosses: `sha256(cross ‖ owner ‖ nonce ‖ side ‖ price ‖ quantity ‖ salt)`.

fields.name: escrow
docs: Quote atoms (buys) or base atoms (sells) held in the vault for this order.

types.name: OrderExt
docs: Per-order extension: where in the call an order was placed and what it asked for.

fields.name: class
docs: Allocation class: 0 general, 1 identity-verified small, 2 locked, 3 priority.

fields.name: lock_cliff
docs: Lock applied to the fill: unlocks after `lock_cliff` seconds and vests over `lock_vest`.

fields.name: ticket
docs: Class-1 lottery ticket: the order's number among the class-1 orders at its tick.

types.name: OrderPlacement
docs: An order's placement and what it asked for, emitted when the cross keeps an order extension.

fields.name: authority
docs: May change the publishers and the minimum.

fields.name: min_matched
docs: A print matching less than this many base atoms never updates the feed.

fields.name: price
docs: Last accepted print: quote atoms per `price_scale` base atoms.

fields.name: guardian
docs: May pause new crosses and orders; can never block claims or refunds.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Protocol fee in bps of filled notional, indexed by [`CrossKind`].

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Proposed next admin; takes over only when it signs `accept_admin` (two-step handover).

types.name: ReferralRules
docs: A referral: the share of the protocol fee that goes to the referrer (PRODUCT_FEATURES W4, W6).
It comes out of the protocol's fee only; the integrator's fee and every bidder's price are untouched.

fields.name: share_bps
docs: Basis points of the protocol fee, at most `MAX_REFERRAL_BPS`.

fields.name: authority
docs: May pause the series, change nothing else, and withdraw its funds.

fields.name: next_index
docs: Crosses spawned so far; the next cross's id.

fields.name: last_price
docs: Price of the last cross that printed (0 until one has).

fields.name: start_ts
docs: Interval mode: the close of the first cross.

fields.name: interval_secs
docs: Interval mode: seconds between closes. 0 means the calendar sets the closes.

fields.name: call_secs
docs: Length of the call window before each close.

fields.name: reveal_secs
docs: Sealed crosses: length of the reveal window after each close.

fields.name: proceeds_to
docs: Where each cross pays out; the default (all zeros) is the series itself, which also returns
the dust bond to the series' funds.

fields.name: max_crosses
docs: 0 = no limit.

fields.name: rules
docs: Rules every spawned cross gets (no bond: the series cannot sign for one).

fields.name: relative
docs: A grid re-centred on the last print each time, instead of the fixed one.

fields.name: min_price
docs: Fixed grid.

fields.name: tick_bps
docs: Relative grid: tick size as basis points of the centre (`ticks` of them, centred).

fields.name: center
docs: Relative grid: the centre of the first cross, before any print exists.

types.name: SupplyLevel
docs: One step of an issuer's pre-committed supply schedule.
